issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The diff changes only two hyperparameters: the clip range for the standardized descriptors goes from ±5 to ±3, and the RBF gamma goes from 1/d to 0.5/d. The mean and sd used for scaling still come from the training fold only (dmu and dsd are computed on D). The candidate does not read files, paste values or use test labels.
No bugs that would make the result meaningless. The kernel is built the same way as before, and the test descriptors are clipped and scaled consistently with the training descriptors.

Recomputed z = (0.4830 - 0.4799) / (0.0070 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/1)) ≈ 0.313. The harness reports 0.306. The gap probably comes from rounding in the displayed means or a slightly different noise sd, and does not matter.

The gain of 0.0031 is less than half the noise sd of a single job, and each side has only one run, so it is not significant. Rejecting provisionally is correct. A replicate would be needed to tell whether the change helps at all.
